description: BabelFish mediates real-time synchrophasor data for power-system applications. ALSETLab publishes two versions: one uses C++ with LabVIEW, and the other is a LabVIEW project. The repository README connects both to the SoftwareX paper and names the IEEE C37.118 stream format. A modeller can take a stream from phasor measurement infrastructure and pass it to monitoring or simulation software through the project interfaces, including a UDP API. Coverage is the connected electrical measurements and their live timestamps; the package has no fixed geographic grid. It could feed power-grid state or digital-twin simulations, but a live integration was not checked here. The public source is free under GPL-3.0. The README requires LabVIEW 2012 or newer, while the mixed version also requires an older Visual Studio edition; separate licence costs and current compatibility were not checked. A limitation is that data quality and latency depend on the upstream measurement system. No related catalogue record was identified. No synchrophasor stream or application was run.
